WITH account_averages AS (
    SELECT
        a.account_id,
        d.A3 AS region,
        AVG(CASE WHEN t.type IN ('PRIJEM', 'VYDAJ') THEN t.amount END) AS amount_avg,
        AVG(t.balance) AS balance_avg
    FROM account AS a
    JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
    JOIN trans AS t ON t.account_id = a.account_id
    GROUP BY a.account_id, d.A3
), region_averages AS (
    SELECT
        region,
        AVG(amount_avg) AS amount_avg,
        AVG(balance_avg) AS balance_avg
    FROM account_averages
    GROUP BY region
), overall_mean AS (
    SELECT AVG(amount_avg) AS mean_amount_avg
    FROM region_averages
)
SELECT
    r.region,
    r.amount_avg,
    r.balance_avg,
    r.amount_avg / m.mean_amount_avg AS amount_avg_over_region_mean
FROM region_averages AS r
CROSS JOIN overall_mean AS m
WHERE m.mean_amount_avg IS NOT NULL;
